description:
Eira is a UAE-based brand dedicated to guiding individuals and organisations from burnout to balance through science-backed, mindful productivity solutions. Our offerings include thoughtfully designed digital journals and physical journals (launching soon), practical online courses (live sessions), and consultancy services tailored to those seeking healthier approaches to work, well-being and life. Rooted in neuroscience, psychology, and mindfulness, our products provide not just tools, but frameworks for sustainable success.

Affiliates in the Eira program earn a 30% commission on every verified sale. Each affiliate receives an affiliate link and an affiliate coupon code, giving their customers a 10% discount at checkout. Commissions are tracked in real time through the affiliate dashboard and paid monthly via bank transfer, with a minimum payout threshold of USD 40. 

Affiliates may use social media, as long as promotion is authentic and professional. While we currently do not provide branded promotional materials, affiliates are welcome to create their own content to share their unique codes and links.

Affiliates are considered independent contractors and are fully responsible for their own taxation and compliance obligations. We expect all promotions to reflect Eira’s values - no hate speech, personal or religious comparisons, or content that may harm communities. Please review the full Terms & Conditions for details. Eira reserves the right to terminate participation in the program if affiliates fail to uphold these standards.

By joining the Eira Affiliate Program, you are not just promoting products - you are contributing to a growing movement that challenges hustle culture and empowers people to live and work with balance, intention, and resilience.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to Eira FZ LLE ("Eira") - From Burnout to Balance! 

Thanks for joining our Affiliate program (the "Programme").

These following terms and conditions apply to persons who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“We” or “Merchant” or "Eira") and an affiliate (“You” or “Affiliate”) who refers customers to use a product or service from Eira.

By participating in the Program,  You agree to use the Program in the manner specified herein, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorised to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approval or Rejection of the Registration

  • All affiliate applications are subject to review. Eira reserves the absolute right to approve or reject any registration at its sole discretion, without obligation to provide a reason.

  • Affiliates must provide accurate and truthful information in their application. Providing false, misleading, or incomplete information is grounds for immediate termination.

  • Affiliates must ensure that participation as an affiliate is legally permitted in their country of residence, including the ability to earn commissions.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

  • Each affiliate will be assigned an affiliate link and/or a unique coupon code.

  • Commissions will be credited once per qualifying order. Double counting of commissions is not permitted.

  • Affiliates may promote Eira only through approved digital platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn). Promotion through blogs, newsletters, email marketing, coupon aggregation sites, or paid search ads on “Eira” brand keywords is prohibited unless expressly approved in writing.

  • Affiliates may not submit codes to third-party coupon, cashback, or discount websites.

3. Commissions and payment

  • Commission is set at 30% of the final order value, excluding taxes, shipping, refunds, chargebacks, or discounts.

  • Commissions are calculated monthly. Payments will be processed within the first ten (10) UAE business days of the following month, subject to the Affiliate meeting the minimum payout threshold of USD 40. This period allows for order verification, including refunds, chargebacks, or fraudulent activity.

  • Affiliates must provide valid payment details in their dashboard. Payments are currently processed only by bank transfer to an account held in the Affiliate’s own name.

  • Transactions deemed fraudulent, cancelled, refunded, or subject to chargebacks will not qualify for commission. Eira reserves the right to withhold or reverse commissions if fraud or abuse is suspected.

  • Use of the Program is subject to a fair use policy. Eira reserves the right to review any referral and withhold payment where necessary to prevent misuse.         

4.  Verification & Banking Compliance

  • To comply with legal, tax, or banking requirements, Eira reserves the right to request identity or business documents from Affiliates.

  • Failure to provide such documents may result in withholding or non-payment of commissions.

  • Eira is not responsible for any delays, rejections, or restrictions caused by banks, payment providers, or regulatory authorities.

5. Marketing tool

  • Eira may provide promotional assets (logos, banners, product information) via the affiliate dashboard.

  • Affiliates must not alter Eira branding, logos, or trademarks without prior written approval.

6. Cookie

  • Eira uses cookies to track affiliate referrals. If a user disables or clears cookies, tracking cannot be guaranteed.

  • Cookie duration is stated on the affiliate registration form. Orders placed within this period will attribute commission to the Affiliate.

  • Technical issues, ad blockers, or customer actions that prevent tracking are outside of Eira’s responsibility.

7. Termination 

Eira reserves the right to suspend or terminate any Affiliate account immediately, at its sole discretion, if the Affiliate:

  • Engages in indecent behavior or content harmful to Eira’s reputation

  • Engages in fraud, abuse, misuse, or illegal activity

  • Provides false or misleading information

  • Violates these Terms and Conditions

  • Promotes Eira in ways inconsistent with Eira’s values or brand integrity.

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@eirabliss.com.

8. Affiliate Conduct

Affiliates agree to:

  • Promote Eira with honesty, respect, transparency and integrity.

  • Not misrepresent themselves as employees, partners, or official representatives of Eira. Affiliates must clearly identify themselves as independent affiliates. 

  • Not use hate speech, harassment, or disrespectful comparisons.

  • Where faith-based products are promoted, affiliates must not compare, disrespect, or speak negatively about any religion, faith, or community.

  • Abide by all local advertising laws and platform guidelines and applicable regulations. 

9. Taxes & Legal Responsibility

  • Affiliates act as independent contractors, not employees or representatives of Eira.

  • Affiliates are solely responsible for ensuring compliance with all local tax, legal, and regulatory obligations in their country of residence.

  • Affiliates are responsible for reporting and paying (as applicable to them) any income tax, VAT, or other taxes due on commissions earned.

  • Eira does not withhold or remit taxes on behalf of Affiliates.

 10. Confidentiality 

Affiliates may not disclose or share non-public information about the Program, including commission structures, internal communications, or dashboard data, without Eira's prior written consent. 

11. Amendments 

  • Eira reserves the right to update or modify these Terms at any time.

  • Continued participation in the Program after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

12. Governing Law & Jurisdiction 

These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United Arab Emirates. Any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Dubai, UAE.

By joining the Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms and Conditions in full. 

Go forward and refer!

We are excited to welcome Affiliates who share our values of mindfulness, peace and respect. By joining the Program, you help us build a community rooted in balance and integrity.  

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@eirabliss.com for support.
